testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-command-availability-source/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:28:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And sketch edit is inactive ✔ When the user opens Sketch1 from the model browser ✔ Then the Sketch ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the 2D sketch workspace shows the existing profile ✔ And Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format groups are displayed ✔ And Finish is available to exit sketch editing ✔ When the user selects Line ✔ Then the Line command prompt requests a start point ✔ And the Line tooltip indicates line and arc creation ✔ When the user exits sketch editing with Finish ✔ Then the previous part workspace and ribbon context return ✔ And Sketch1 remains in the model browser
